# ANALYSIS: BEARISH_REJECTION_VIX_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX rising/above 20 filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will avoid losses on loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) while preserving all winner day entries. The VIX confirmation aligns with the bearish thesis: rising VIX indicates increasing fear, strengthening the rejection signal.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Requires BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence) AND VIX rising OR VIX >= 20 at time of entry.  
**Exit:** Identical to base setup: chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), TP1 at +50% (2/3 contracts), runner exit on ribbon re-entry or +300% premium.
